content.comment_body: Hi, I checked the user manual, specifically the section about security on page 294. It explains how to prevent program copying and how to set a password to protect your program via the device menu. My question is, how can I protect the program from being copied if the device does not have a display? Is it possible to do this using the software? Regards
Hi [user_name], You can secure your program using [product_name] as mentioned in [url]. Regards,

If your device does not have a display, you can only activate program password protection through [product_name] by accessing: File -> Properties - Program password. The copy protection for the SD card cannot be set via [product_name]; that option is not available.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking ways to secure their programs from copying on devices without a display. While password protection can be set using software, certain features like SD card copy protection are unavailable through software alone on display-less devices, leading to uncertainty about how completely programs can be safeguarded in these cases.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to be able to fully protect their programs from copying on devices without a display, preferably through software-only options such as [product_name].
